sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.help: Sessions corpus indexing and visibility settings

sessions.visibility.label: Sessions Visibility
sessions.visibility.help: Visibility scope for sessions corpus: current (default), off, or visible (requires visibility guard support).

sessions.sync.label: Sessions Delta Sync
sessions.sync.help: Thresholds controlling when transcript updates trigger sessions index sync.

sessions.sync.deltaBytes.label: Delta Bytes
sessions.sync.deltaBytes.help: Minimum appended bytes before reindexing sessions transcripts.

sessions.sync.deltaMessages.label: Delta Messages
sessions.sync.deltaMessages.help: Minimum appended message records before reindexing sessions transcripts.

import.label: Import
import.help: Migration behavior when legacy memory files exist

import.cleanupMemoryMdAfterImport.label: Cleanup MEMORY.md After Import
import.cleanupMemoryMdAfterImport.help: When true (default), after importing legacy MEMORY.md into Postgres AnchorClaw writes a backup into .openclaw-repair/anchorclaw/ and stubs MEMORY.md to avoid duplicate prompt injection.

maintenance.enabled.label: Enable Maintenance
maintenance.enabled.help: Enable periodic DB-owned maintenance cycle that processes session index chunks into maintenance events.

maintenance.dryRun.label: Maintenance Dry Run
maintenance.dryRun.help: When true (default), maintenance scans and classifies candidates but does not persist events.

maintenance.intervalMinutes.label: Maintenance Interval (minutes)
maintenance.intervalMinutes.help: How often the maintenance cycle runs after maintenance.enabled is set. Defaults to 720 minutes (12 hours).

maintenance.batchSize.label: Maintenance Batch Size
maintenance.batchSize.help: Maximum number of indexed session chunks processed per cycle.

maintenance.extractor.label: Maintenance Extractor
maintenance.extractor.help: Model-assisted JSON extractor settings for durable-memory promotion.

maintenance.extractor.enabled.label: Enable Extractor
maintenance.extractor.enabled.help: When true, non-dry-run maintenance asks an agent for structured durable-memory candidates.

maintenance.extractor.agentId.label: Extractor Agent Id
maintenance.extractor.agentId.help: Agent id used for internal extraction calls.

maintenance.extractor.maxCandidates.label: Extractor Max Candidates
maintenance.extractor.maxCandidates.help: Maximum candidate memories requested from extractor per source window.

maintenance.extractor.maxCharsPerRun.label: Extractor Max Chars
maintenance.extractor.maxCharsPerRun.help: Maximum transcript characters passed to extractor per source window.

identity.label: Identity
identity.help: Stable owner identity for memory scoping

identity.externalId.label: External Identity
identity.externalId.help: Stable identity key (max 20 chars). Recommended for Docker/production to avoid memory scope drift.

postgres.label: Postgres
postgres.help: Postgres connection settings for AnchorClaw memory storage

workspaceDir.label: Workspace Directory
workspaceDir.help: Explicit workspace root used by AnchorClaw for import, workspace scoping, prompt cache, and memory/* reads.

postgres.schema.label: Schema
postgres.schema.help: Optional Postgres schema for AnchorClaw tables (recommended to avoid polluting public)

postgres.sslMode.label: SSL Mode
postgres.sslMode.help: SSL mode: disable, require (no cert verification), or verify-full (verify server certificate)

postgres.sslCa.label: SSL CA
postgres.sslCa.help: Optional CA PEM bundle for verify-full; supports ${ENV_VAR} values

postgres.pool.max.label: Max Connections
postgres.pool.max.help: Maximum number of connections in the pool

postgres.pool.connectionTimeoutMs.label: Connect Timeout (ms)
postgres.pool.connectionTimeoutMs.help: Time to wait for a connection before failing

postgres.pool.idleTimeoutMs.label: Idle Timeout (ms)
postgres.pool.idleTimeoutMs.help: Time before an idle connection is closed

limits.getDefaultLines.label: Get Default Lines
limits.getDefaultLines.help: Default lineCount for memory_get when omitted (cap: 120)
